fields.label: Kunlik ishlab chiqarish quvvati (kg)
fields.description: Bir kunda ishlab chiqarish mumkin bo'lgan jami mahsulot (kg). Masalan: 180 tonna/oy ÷ 26 ish kuni ≈ 6900 kg

fields.label: Kesim vaqti (abed chegarasi)
fields.description: Shu vaqtgacha kelgan zakaz bugungi rejaga tushadi (joy bo'lsa), keyin kelgani — ertangi kunga

fields.label: Bitta zames og'irligi (kg)
fields.description: Kutterga bir marta sig'adigan miqdor. Har mahsulot uchun kerakli zames soni shu songa bo'lib (yuqoriga yaxlitlab) hisoblanadi

fields.label: Yakshanba ham ishlaydi
fields.description: Belgilanmagan bo'lsa reja yakshanbani sakrab o'tadi (6 kunlik ish haftasi)
